absent: Numeric values of maximum buddy order, pageblock order, costly order, shuffle order, and migratetype enumeration.
Full layouts of zone, page, folio, per CPU pages, RCU per CPU node, and reporting device structures.

findings.text: Per zone counter update accumulates a delta into a per CPU difference cell and flushes to the shared zone counter only when the absolute accumulated value exceeds a per CPU threshold, resetting the cell after flush.
Allocation tag release looks up the tag reference associated with a page, subtracts usage proportional to the number of pages being freed, then updates and releases the reference handle.
Tail placement choice consumes one bit at a time from a cached random word, refilling the cache when exhausted, with no locking by design.
Reporting notification entry observes a globally shared reporting device under read side protection and issues a request only when the device is present.
Checked page free derives the frame number and home zone from the page, runs a preparation predicate, and only on success inserts the range into the buddy system.
Buddy identity requires guard or buddy marking, exact order match from stored private state, and identical zone identity; the candidate frame number is derived by toggling the bit for the order.

Free accounting ignores isolated blocks entirely, tracks total free pages always, and separately tracks contiguous reclaimable or high atomic reserves; large block accounting applies only at or above pageblock granularity for non isolated types.
Pageblock type assignment forces unmovable when mobility grouping is disabled, refuses direct isolation changes with warnings, and otherwise updates only the type and isolation bits atomically.

Sanitizer poisoning is skipped while deferred page initialization is active in one build, otherwise by comparing the page tag against the kernel tag; clearing of tagged high pages runs with current checking disabled.
Tag subtraction is either gated on allocation profiling being enabled or compiled to an empty operation.
Reporting free notification and reported state are either gated on a global enable switch plus an order threshold or compiled to inactive no operation forms.
Shuffle handling is either gated on a global key plus a minimum order or compiled to always false, with the tail picker likewise either random or constant false.
Range validation either checks both span membership and home zone equality or is compiled to always valid.

Compaction capture requires an eligible non kernel task context for the same zone without a captured page, exact order match, refusal of contiguous reclaimable and isolated types, and a guard against polluting movable blocks with smaller orders.

Buddy insertion serializes on the zone lock with interrupts saved; a no lock request attempts only a try lock and on failure queues the page on a lockless overflow list for later draining under a full lock.

Deferred RCU freeing holds a per CPU lock with interrupts saved while updating the free RCU counter, appending to pending, and possibly starting a batch; the expedite size check is deliberately lockless.
Per CPU counter updates run under nested preemption disable to protect the read modify write; reporting device lookup runs under read side protection.
Per CPU page cache draining may temporarily release its lock between batches, reacquire with a try lock, and abort with an unlocked indication on failure or on CPU migration.

Buddy release credits the range, attempts capture then repeated merging with an available buddy while below the maximum order, aligns mismatched block types to the freed type, records final order, chooses head or tail placement, inserts, and optionally reports.
RCU deferred pages accumulate on pending; start moves all pending to batch only when no batch is in flight and queues RCU work, while a separate expedited work is queued when pending exceeds a limit.

Reporting requests move from idle to requested with an atomic exchange; already requested or active states cause return without further action, and a successful transition schedules delayed work to batch arrivals.

Per CPU freeing caches the page on an order and type indexed list, decays the allocation factor, tracks consecutive costly high order frees with flags, and evicts in batches once a computed high mark is reached.

Free organization uses per zone per order areas each with per migratetype queues and counts, plus a lockless overflow list storing order in page private state and a spanned range used for boundary checks.

Per CPU state includes a page cache with indexed lists, total count, batch and low marks, behavior flags and allocation and free counters, and an RCU batch node with pending and active queues, pending count, and two work items.

Several races are intentional: unlocked random word updates, stale pending size shifting expedite by one free, and no lock paths temporarily letting cached or overflow counts exceed their high marks rather than blocking.
Large free ranges are split into at most pageblock sized chunks with alignment and non buddy preconditions; guard pages are cleared rather than unlinked and reported marks are cleared on removal.
Zone span membership is read under a sequence retry loop to tolerate concurrent span updates, logging identifying range details when the page lies outside.
